Journey-level classification across all four reported travel legs (Q429b-Q432b block), CORRECTED 2026-09-14 for numeric-zero handling and DNK-as-unresolved. 143 journeys are legitimate zero fares -- every administered leg is either 'do not pay' (a stated zero) or a named payment period with a reported cost of exactly R0 (a numeric zero, answered rather than skip-implied); 2 of the 143 involve at least one numeric-zero leg rather than being 'do not pay' on every leg. 2252 journeys are fully costed positive (every administered leg resolves to a known value -- zero or a positive number -- with at least one positive). 2 journeys are partially observed positive: at least one leg carries a positive cost but at least one other administered leg is unresolved (unspecified cost, an internal inconsistency, or the payment period itself recorded as 'do not know' -- a DNK leg is NOT treated as a free pass to 'fully costed' merely because another leg paid), so the journey is known to involve real payment but its total is not fully observed. Of the 2254 usable-numeric journeys, 2238 have a numeric FIRST-leg cost alone (this count is not itself zero/positive-split -- see transport_provisional_reconstruction.csv for the positive-only per-period figures); 18 were reported free on leg 1 but paid on a later leg and were wrongly zeroed out by a leg-1-only reading. 7 journeys have no positive leg but at least one unresolvable leg (mixing zero-fare legs with an ambiguous-cost, internal-inconsistency, or DNK leg, so the total is not confirmed zero). 4 report 'do not know' as the payment period on every administered leg.
